subject: Coordinating demo across US customer, EU engineering & APAC support (availability + DST note)
messages:
From: Samira Patel <samira.patel@openhealth.co>
To: ava.chen@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 9 Mar 2024 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Demo - coordinating timing with EU eng and APAC ops

Hi Ava,

Thanks again for the quick reply on the PoC. We want to get a live demo scheduled with our product and ops teams. A couple of constraints on our side:
- Our core product folks on the East Coast prefer 9:00–11:30 AM ET.
- We definitely need engineering from your EU office on the call for the integration questions.
- Our APAC sysops (Singapore) can only join late evening their time (they flagged 9:00 PM SGT or later).

We're aware US DST kicks in on Mar 10 — that may affect the offset for a couple days. Can you confirm what works for your EU engs and whether you can arrange an overlap window that hits our morning but isn't too late for EU? Ideally a time that lets APAC dial in after-hours if necessary or we record the session.

Tentative dates we can do: Mar 11–13 (flexible on day). Please propose 2-3 windows and we'll pick.

Also loop in procurement for the eventual contracting discussion: procurement@openhealth.co (they may need a calendar invite and agenda).

Thanks,
Samira
Director, Product
OpenHealth
[attachment: high-level-requirements.pdf (PDF)]

From: ava.chen@redwood.ai
To: Samira Patel <samira.patel@openhealth.co>
Cc: marcus.lin@redwood.ai, hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 9 Mar 2024 12:05:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Demo - coordinating timing with EU eng and APAC ops

Hi Samira — great to meet you over email.

Thanks for the constraints. Quick proposal:
- Option A: Mar 11, 9:30 AM ET (15:30 CET / 23:30 SGT) — EU can join in their afternoon, APAC would be late but still possible to dial in.
- Option B: Mar 12, 10:00 AM ET (16:00 CET / 00:00 SGT) — slightly later for APAC.
- Option C: Mar 13, 8:30 AM ET (14:30 CET / 22:30 SGT) — earlier for EU, a little friendlier for APAC.

We can also record and share the recording with APAC if they prefer not to join live. Marcus (EU engineering) and Hannah (sales ops) are cc'd to confirm availability and whether they'd prefer we shift days to avoid the DST transition on Mar 10.

Agenda draft (high level):
- 10 min intros
- 25 min demo + integration Qs (Marcus)
- 15 min ops & data handling (Hannah)
- 10 min next steps / procurement path

I'll attach a short agenda and will send a calendar invite after we lock the slot.

Best,
Ava
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[attachment: draft-demo-agenda.pdf (PDF)]

From: marcus.lin@redwood.ai
To: ava.chen@redwood.ai
Cc: hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 11 Mar 2024 09:02:00 +01:00
Subject: RE: Demo - coordinating timing with EU eng and APAC ops

Ava — quick internal note before we reply to Samira:

- EU engineering (me + two ICs) are available Mar 11 after 14:00 CET and Mar 12 all afternoon. Mar 13 morning (before 11:00 CET) also works if we keep it short.
- APAC support can join live only if the call is before 23:30 SGT; otherwise they ask for a recording and a short async Q&A slot.
- Because US DST starts on Mar 10, the ET->CET offset changes from -5 to -4 on the US side; that means the mapping for Mar 11–12 has to account for DST having started in the US (US jumped forward one hour). Double-checked our calendar conversions.

Recommendation: lock Mar 13 08:30–09:15 ET (14:30–15:15 CET) — that hits EU early afternoon, is within our engineers' windows, and is 21:30 SGT (APAC can join or review recording). If OpenHealth insists on Mar 11/12, we can do Mar 12 10:00 ET but APAC will likely be midnight.

Also note: Marcus here — I'll be the primary tech presenter. Please include the integration checklist in the invite so we can pre-load any sample data details.

-- Marcus
Senior Engineer, Redwood Inference

[internal: keep the call to 45 minutes to respect EU schedules]

Ava / Marcus — thanks for the options and the DST heads-up. We prefer to avoid the weekend and would like engineering on the call live. Given that, Mar 13 at 08:30 ET works best for us. A few notes:

- Can you please send a calendar invite in ET timezone and include a 10–15 minute buffer before the call for quick setup/access checks?
- Procurement copied here will want the demo agenda and any notes on required data access for the PoC.
- If APAC cannot be live, recording + an async Q&A thread is fine. They may send follow-ups.

Please also avoid scheduling on Mar 10/11 as DST transition days for us — we had calendar confusion historically on those exact days.

Looking forward to it.

Best,
Samira
